images.filename: Cultural Landscape Reports- Preservation Planning for a Changing Environment (7) (fe4baa71-74a9-41bf-be9b-6cb21cd790dd).png
images.caption:
Caption: In the face of a changing climate, parks are faced  with a difficult task: preserving varied historic landscapes, while adapting to a warming climate. Image: Map of the four landscape character areas at Oakland Plantation, showing vegetation recommendations for the various areas.
"In the face of a changing climate, parks are faced  with a difficult task: preserving varied historic landscapes, while adapting to a warming climate." The Treatment Plan Overview is presented by Landscape Character Area in the Oakland Plantation Cultural Landscape Report, Cane River Creole National Historical Park.
These images were prepared as part of a series focusing on cultural landscape reports and historic structure reports, highlighting examples and illustrating how the reports relate to preservation history in the National Park System.
Keywords: cultural landscape; CLR
